fields.label: MLH1 nuclear expression
options: Loss of nuclear expression (internal control intact)

reference.title: CAP MMR IHC & MSI interpretation and Lynch reflex algorithm
reference.intro: Any unequivocal nuclear staining in tumour cells (even focal, weaker than internal control) is scored as intact. Confirmed loss requires an intact positive internal control (stromal cells, lymphocytes, or normal crypts).
reference.note: Photomicrographs are from Wikimedia Commons under open Creative Commons licences. ExpertPath pages open with your own ExpertPath login; the app holds none of their images.

groups.heading: Reflex testing algorithm & MMR IHC patterns
points: Loss of MLH1 + PMS2: in colorectal carcinoma test BRAF V600E (or MLH1 promoter hypermethylation); in endometrial carcinoma test MLH1 promoter hypermethylation directly (BRAF is not informative).
Loss of MSH2 + MSH6, isolated MSH6 loss, or isolated PMS2 loss: high likelihood of Lynch syndrome — recommend genetic counselling and germline testing.

images.caption: Colorectal adenocarcinoma showing complete loss of MLH1 nuclear expression in tumour glands with intact positive stromal and lymphocytic internal control.
